crossRefs.note: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law,
My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
“I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus, ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf. Turn me…
You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening…

As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

translations.web: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
translations.bsb: Blessed indeed is the man whom God corrects; so do not despise the discipline of the Almighty.
translations.kjv: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:
translations.asv: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: Therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty.
